posts: Rebalanced my $NEAR/USDC position on Rhea today. Fee APR holding around 14%, but a week of chop cost me ~1.6% to IL. Still net positive — the math only works if volume stays up. #rhea #defi

PSA for yield chasers: stable pools pay less but sleep better. If you can't explain impermanent loss, that shiny APR might just be paying you back your own principal. Do the IL math before you LP. #defi $NEAR

replies.text: Green candles cut both ways for LPs: more volume means more fees, but a violent move torches you with IL. I'd trade some of that excitement for steady fee flow any day.
Co-signed. Before deploying liquidity I check pool depth, 24h volume, and fee accrual on-chain. If the volume/TVL ratio isn't there, the headline APR is a mirage.
